donor_pairs: Exactly two opposite-label rows; pair_id shared; same task, wrapper, source seed and controlled content
cluster_unit: Wrapper shared across all four tasks, sampled jointly; 24 clusters per eval split

split_roles.train: Independent from-scratch training and train-only few-shot examples
split_roles.calibration: Task competence and prompt format selection only
split_roles.D2: Alignment, weights, reference distributions and effect normalization

arithmetic: Addition operands0..127; false sum same parity and decimal digit length as true sum, sampled broadly instead of +/-1
comparison: Same-width unequal operands with greater/less relation; matched donor reverses operand order
negation: Three explicit Boolean assignments, nonnumeric variable names, AND/OR/XOR/NOT expressions; paired assignments have equal true-count and opposite query value
syntax: Balanced typed brackets with5..8pairs; invalid donor swaps differing closing types, preserving character multiset and complete open/close skeleton
split_exclusion: Unordered numeric operand tuple across both arithmetic and comparison
data_source: Project-authored deterministic synthetic data; no external corpus or paid API
freeze_behavior: Refuse overwriting divergent existing files; identical content resumes; loader verifies byte and record hashes
limitations: 24 wrappers are distinct written instructions, not independently sampled semantic grammars
Conditional inference over these wrappers does not establish broad natural-language generalization
False sums may retain higher-order digit or value-distribution differences beyond controlled parity and width
Bracket errors may leave local type mismatch cues; multiset and skeleton matching do not prove recursive parsing
Generation seeds are not model initialization seeds
Boolean expressions are from a restricted finite family
No original pilot-v1 source, data, or results are modified
